_comment: Chickens pillar SCORING config (Phase 3). Separate from balance.json (which holds the cross-pillar importance/target the Balance engine ranks by). This file tunes how the Chickens synthesizer (lib/chickens-synthesizer.mjs) turns mood_events + bfrb_events + history + the borrowed physicals RECORD into the 5 Area sub-scores and the composite. Kyle's tuning surface — edit values here, no code change. NOTE: weights + targets are council-invented defaults ratified at the Phase-3 gate (mood target ~3.8/5 → 70, mindfulness 4 sessions/14d, focus 600 min/14d); the stress Area is deliberately low-weighted (0.10) so Chickens isn't dominated by Physicals double-counting. bfrb.bands are last-7d/prior-7d trend-ratio cutoffs paired index-wise with bfrb.scores (the final score is the else-bracket).
